name: Jack's Treasure-of-the-Seas Grilled Shrimp, Scallops & Pasta (Pirate Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: Grilled shrimp and sea scallops over white pasta provide lean marine protein and low-residue carbohydrates.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the shrimp, scallops, and pasta tossed in plain butter or olive oil instead of the lemon-tomato cream sauce to stay 100% citrus-free.
watchOuts: Lemon-tomato cream sauce on standard build (swap for plain butter/olive oil)
